summary: Read an array of integers and an integer named k. Count how many contiguous intervals have entries that add up to exactly k, then write that count. The array length runs from 1 to 2 * 104, each entry runs from -1000 to 1000, and k runs from -10^7 to 10^7. Intervals with different starts or different ends are counted apart even when their sums are equal.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is a count, that many integers, and one target integer.
